steps.title: Scan the repository
steps.note: Classifies every file and writes inventory.json and the run record.

steps.title: Resolve imports
steps.note: Reads the inventory, parses supported languages and writes graph.json.

steps.title: Render the report
steps.note: Checks the snapshot, audits the graph and writes report.html.

title: Arche turns a repository into an offline report in three steps
summary: scan.py lists and classifies files, imports.py resolves static imports into a graph, and render.py validates both artifacts and writes report.html. Each step hands files to the next through the shared output directory.
